summary: Completed comprehensive backend and frontend testing for Lakeview Burgers & Seafood restaurant website. All 13 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend testing verified landing page, login flow, dashboard analytics, and specials management functionality.
seed_data_creation: Test specials created during testing were cleaned up after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: All features working correctly. The N+1 MongoDB query fix and referrer filter bug fix mentioned in previous iteration are working correctly.
